name: Aura of Purity

source.note: Not in the free 2024 Basic Rules; written from knowledge of the 2024 PHB and cross-checked against aidedd.org's 2024 entry. Level, school, classes, casting time, range, components, duration and Concentration match the D&D Beyond 2024 spell list.

targets.description: you and your allies while in the aura

summary: 30-foot aura: Resistance to Poison and Advantage on saves against seven conditions for you and your allies.
text: Purifying energy radiates from you in a 30-foot Emanation for the duration. While in it, you and your allies have Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end effects that include the Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned or Stunned condition. Concentration, up to 10 minutes.
